rationale: P12 moves the Android motion JNI bridge (jni_motion.cpp) unchanged from core/platform/src/android to core/view/platform/android so the foundation layer has no view include; it remains a pulp-jni source with the identical exported symbol set, the motion bridge test compiles it from the new path, and the foundation include lint allowlist is emptied. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging, or Vellum source authority moves.
